Record a voice note on your Garmin watch and listen to it right on your wrist. You can also copy notes off the watch.

[Compatibility](compatibility.qmd) · [Install](install.qmd)

## Record {#record-a-note}

1. Open **Voicenotes** on your watch.
2. Press **START** or tap the microphone to record.
3. Press **START** or **BACK**, or tap the stop icon, to save.

Recordings stop after one minute by default. In **Saved notes → Settings**, you can change **Max length**, turn on **Auto-record**, or adjust vibration.

## Play or delete {#listen-to-or-delete-a-note}

1. From the main screen, tap the list icon at the bottom or press **MENU** or **DOWN** to open **Saved notes**.
2. Select a recording.
3. Tap the screen or press **START** to play.

To remove a recording, open it, swipe left or choose **MENU → Delete**, then select **Delete permanently**.

## Export {#copy-a-note-off-your-watch}

- [Sync to an Android phone](android-sync.qmd) from a fēnix 8.
- [Upload to your own server](upload.qmd) using HTTPS.

Both options keep the original on your watch.
